title: 第3章本座的师哥
slug: 二哈和他的白猫师尊皓衣行
content_zh:
嗯……既然自己灵魂回来了，那前世的雄厚修为，会不会也跟着回来了？
墨燃调动法咒，感受了一□□内灵力的攒涌，虽然充沛，但却并不强大。也就是说他的修为并没有继承过来。
不过这也没什么，他天资聪颖，悟性又高，大不了重头修炼，也没什么了不起的。更何况重生是一件天大的喜事，即便有些美不足，那也都很正常。墨燃这样想着，很快收敛起了自己的阴暗和獠牙，像个十五岁少年该有的模样，高高兴兴地准备返回门派。
城郊夏意浓，偶有车马驰过，车轮滚滚，无人会去注意此时才年方十五岁的墨燃。
只偶尔有田间忙碌的村妇，得了空抬头抹汗，瞧见个格外标致的少年，会眼前一亮，盯着看两眼。
墨燃也笑嘻嘻地，毫不客气地看回去，直把那些有夫之妇看得满脸绯红，低下头来。
傍晚时分，墨燃来到无常镇，这里离死生之巅很近了，暮色里一轮红日如血，火烧云霞衬着巍峨峰峦。一摸肚子，有些饿了，他于是熟门熟路地进了家酒楼，瞅着柜前那一溜红底黑字的菜牌子，敲敲柜台，麻利地点道：“掌柜的，来一只棒棒鸡，一碟夫妻肺片儿，打两斤烧酒，再切一盘儿牛肉。”
这当口打尖儿的人很多，热闹的紧，说书先生在台子上摇着扇子，正在讲死生之巅的故事，说的是眉飞色舞，唾沫横飞。
墨燃要了个临窗的包间，边吃饭，边听人家讲书。
“众所周知啊，咱们修真界按照地域划分，分为上修和下修两片区域，今儿我们就来讲一讲下修界最了不起的门派，死生之巅。嘿，要知道啊，咱们这座无常镇百年前曾是一座荒凉动荡的穷破小镇，因为离鬼界入口进，天一黑，村民们都不敢出门，如果非要行夜路，必须摇着驱魔铃，洒着香灰纸钱，一边喊着“人来隔重山，鬼来隔重纸”，一边快速通过。但今天看来，咱们镇热闹繁华，与别处并无区别，这可全仰仗着死生之巅的照拂。这座仙邸呀，它不偏不倚，正好修在那鬼门关的入口，横在这阴阳两界之间。它建派虽然不久，但……”
这段历史，墨燃听着耳朵都快起茧子了，于是兴趣缺缺地便开始朝着窗下走神张望。正巧，楼下支了个摊子，几个道士打扮的外乡人运着个黑布蒙着的笼子，正在街头耍把戏卖艺。
这可比老先生说书有意思多啦。
墨燃的注意力被吸引了过去。
“瞧一瞧，看一看，这是上古凶兽貔貅幼兽，被我等降伏。如今乖顺似小儿，还会杂耍、算术！行侠仗义不容易，各位有钱的捧个钱场，没钱的捧个人场，来看第一场好戏——貔貅打算盘！”
只见那几个道士哗地掀了黑布，笼子里关着的，赫然是几个人脸熊身的妖兽。
墨燃：“………………”
就这些低眉顺眼毛茸茸的狗熊崽子？？也敢说是貔貅？？？
这牛真可快吹破天了，谁信谁驴脑子。
但墨燃没过多久就开眼了，二三十个驴脑子聚在他们周围看戏，时不时喝彩鼓掌，那个热闹劲儿，连酒楼里的人都忍不住探头出去看了，弄得说书先生好不尴尬。
“如今死生之巅的尊主，那叫一个威名赫赫，声名远扬——”

“好！！再来一段！！！”
说书先生大受鼓舞，循声望去，只见那客人满面红光，兴奋异常，但目光瞅着的显然不是自己，而是楼下的杂耍摊子。
“哟，貔貅打算盘呢？”
“啊呀呀，好厉害啊！”
“好！精彩！再演一段貔貅抛苹果！”
满楼的人嘎嘎笑开了，都聚到窗栏边去看下面的热闹。说书先生还在可怜巴巴地继续讲：“尊主最有名的，就是他的那一柄扇子，他……”
“啊哈哈哈，那个毛色最淡的貔貅想要抢苹果吃呢，你看它还在地上打滚！”
说书先生拿汗巾擦着脸，气得嘴唇有些抖。
墨燃抿了抿嘴唇，展颜笑了，在珠帘后面慢条斯理地喊了一声：“别讲死生之巅了，来段《十摸》，保准把人都拉回来。”
说书先生不知道帘子后面的人正是死生之巅的公子墨燃，很有气节地嗑巴道：“粗、粗鄙之词，不登，不登大雅之堂。”
墨燃笑道：“就这儿还大雅之堂？你也不臊得慌。”
说罢，忽听得楼下一阵喧闹。
“哎呀！好快的马！”
“是死生之巅的仙君吧！”
议论纷纷，一匹黑马自死生之巅的方向奔踏而来，闪电一般杀进那杂耍圈！
那马匹上坐着两个人，一个戴着黑色斗笠，裹着黑披风，挡得严严实实，看不出年龄性别，另一个则是个三四十岁的妇人，粗手笨脚，满面风霜。
妇人一见那些人熊就哭开了，她连滚带爬地下了马，跌跌撞撞地就冲过去，抱住了其一只人熊就跪地嚎啕起来：“儿啊！！！我的儿啊——”
周围的人都懵了。有人挠着头喃喃道：“耶？这不是上古神兽貔貅的幼崽子吗？这女的怎么管它叫儿？”
“这该不会是母貔貅吧。”
“哎哟，那么厉害啊，这母的都修成人形啦。”

这边村民没见识，在那边胡言乱语着，但墨燃却琢磨过来了。
相传，有些江湖道士会去拐骗小孩，然后将孩子的舌头拔掉，让他们说不出话来，再拿滚水烫掉小孩的皮，趁着血肉模糊之际，把兽皮粘在他们身上，鲜血凝固之后，皮毛和小孩粘合在一起，看起来就和妖怪无异。这些孩子不会说话，不会写字，只能任由人欺凌，配合着表演“貔貅打算盘”这种杂耍，如果反抗，引来的就是一阵棍棒鞭打。
难怪先前他感受不到丝毫妖气，这些“貔貅”根本不是妖，而是活生生的人啊……
这边正兀自思考着，那边那个黑斗篷低声和那几个道士说了几句什么话，那几个道士闻言，竟是瞬间暴怒，嘴里嚷着“道歉？你爷爷就不知道道歉这俩字怎么写！”“死生之巅有什么了不起的？”“多管闲事，给我打！”扑上去就要围殴黑斗篷。
“哎哟。”
眼见同门被打，墨燃却是低低笑了两声，“这么凶呀。”
他丝毫没有出手相助的意思。前世，他就特讨厌本门这种路见不平拔刀相助的门派氛围，一个两个都跟傻子似的往上冲，村口王大妈的猫崽子爬树下不来了都要他们来帮忙，派从掌门到杂役，各个缺心眼儿。
天下不公平事那么多，管什么管呀，累死个人。
“打起来了打起来了！喝！好厉害的拳头！”
酒楼上下，众人乌泱泱地围将过去凑热闹。
“那么多人打一个，要不要脸啊！”
“仙君当心身后啊！哎呀！好险！哇呀呀呀——”
“这一击躲得好！”
这些人爱看打架，墨燃可不爱看，他见过的血雨腥风多了去了，眼皮子底下发生的事对他而言就跟苍蝇嗡嗡似的。他懒洋洋地掸掸衣服上的花生碎屑，起身离开。
下了楼，那几个道士正和黑斗篷斗得难分上下，剑气嗖嗖的，墨燃抱着双臂，靠在酒肆门口，只瞥了一眼，就忍不住啧了一声。
死生之巅各个都是以一当十的凶悍勇猛，这黑斗篷打架却不厉害，眼见着都被那几个江湖道士拉下马，围在间猛踹了，却还不下狠手。
反而弱弱地喊了句：“君子动手不动口，与你们讲道理，你们为何不听？！”
道士们：“………………”
墨燃：“……………………”
道士们想的是，啥？这人，都被打成这副奶奶样了，还君子动口不动手？这是馒头瓤子的脑壳儿，没馅儿吧？

墨燃则脸色骤变，一时间有些天旋地转，他摈住呼吸，难以置信地睁大了眼睛——这个声音……
“师昧！”墨燃低喝着急奔上来，灌满灵力一掌打出，就将五个为非作歹的江湖道士统统震开！他跪坐在地上，扶起了满身泥灰脚印的黑斗篷，嗓音都忍不住微微发颤——
“师昧，是你吗？”
作者有话要说：虽然他的名字叫师昧，但是人家真的是师哥啦，是师哥23333
content_en:
Hmm... Now that my soul is back, will the strong cultivation level from my previous life also come back?
Mo Ran mobilized the spell and felt the surge of spiritual power within him. Although it was abundant, it was not powerful. In other words, his cultivation was not inherited.
But it doesn't matter. He is talented and has a high level of understanding. At worst, it won't be a big deal if he starts training again. What's more, rebirth is a great joy. Even if there are some imperfections, it is normal. Mo Ran thought like this, and quickly restrained his darkness and fangs, looking like a fifteen-year-old boy, happily preparing to return to the sect.
The summer atmosphere is thick in the outskirts of the city, and occasionally there are cars and horses passing by, and the wheels are rolling. No one will pay attention to Mo Ran, who is only fifteen years old at this time.
Occasionally, a village woman who was busy in the fields would look up and wipe her sweat when she had time. When she saw a particularly handsome young man, her eyes would light up and she would stare at him twice.
Mo Ran also smiled and looked back unceremoniously, until the married women looked at them with blushing faces and lowered their heads.
In the evening, Mo Ran came to Wuchang Town, which was very close to the top of life and death. In the twilight, a red sun was like blood, and the burning clouds set off the majestic peaks. Feeling hungry, he walked into a restaurant by familiar means, looked at the row of red and black food labels in front of the counter, knocked on the counter, and said quickly: "Shopkeeper, please bring a Bangbang chicken, a plate of couple's lung slices, two kilograms of soju, and a plate of beef."
There were a lot of people talking about it, and it was very lively. The storyteller was shaking his fan on the stage and telling stories about the peak of life and death.
Mo Ran asked for a private room by the window, eating and listening to others' lectures.
"As we all know, our world of cultivation is divided into two areas: upper cultivation and lower cultivation. Today we will talk about the most amazing sect in the lower cultivation world, the pinnacle of death and life. Hey, you must know that our Wuchang town was a desolate and turbulent poor town a hundred years ago. Because of the entrance to the ghost world, when it gets dark, the villagers dare not go out. If you have to walk at night, you must Ringing the exorcism bell, scattering incense and paper money, while shouting "people come to separate the mountains, ghosts come to separate the paper" while passing quickly. But today, it seems that our town is lively and prosperous, and it is no different from other places. This is all due to the care of the top of life and death. This fairy mansion is just at the entrance of the ghost gate, between the yin and yang worlds. Although it was established not long ago, but..."
During this period of history, Mo Ran's ears almost became calluses when he heard it, so he began to look under the window without interest. By chance, a stall was set up downstairs, and a few foreigners dressed as Taoist priests were carrying a cage covered with black cloth and performing tricks on the street.
This is much more interesting than the old gentleman’s storytelling.
The ink-burning attention was attracted.
"Take a look, take a look, this is the cub of the ancient ferocious beast Pixiu, who was subdued by us. Now he is as obedient as a child, and he can also juggle and do arithmetic! It is not easy to be a chivalrous person. Those who are rich will support you with money, and those who have no money will support you personally. Come and watch the first good show - Pixiu Abacus!"
I saw the Taoist priests slamming down the black cloth, and what was locked in the cage were several monster beasts with human faces and bear bodies.
Mo Ran: "………………"
Just these furry bear cubs with low eyebrows and submissive eyes? ? Do you dare to say it’s Pixiu? ? ?
This guy is so awesome, no one will believe him.
But it didn't take long for Mo Ran to open his eyes. Twenty or thirty donkey brains gathered around them to watch the show, cheering and applauding from time to time. The excitement was such that even the people in the restaurant couldn't help but poke their heads out to watch, which made the storyteller feel very embarrassed.
"The Lord who is now at the top of life and death is a man of great authority and fame -"
"Okay!! One more section!!!"
The storyteller was greatly encouraged. He followed the sound and saw that the guest's face was red and excited, but his eyes were obviously not clear.It was me, but the sideshow stall downstairs.
"Hey, where's Pixiu's abacus?"
"Ah, ah, that's awesome!"
"Okay! Wonderful! Let's do another Pixiu tossing an apple!"
People all over the building burst into laughter and gathered at the window bars to watch the excitement below. The storyteller continued pitifully: "The Lord is most famous for his fan. He..."
"Ah hahaha, that Pixiu with the lightest fur wants to grab the apple and eat it, look at it, it's still rolling on the ground!"
The storyteller wiped his face with a sweat towel, his lips trembling with anger.
Mo Ran pursed his lips, smiled, and shouted slowly from behind the bead curtain: "Stop talking about the peak of life and death, let's do the "Ten Touches", and I'm sure to bring everyone back."
The storyteller did not know that the person behind the curtain was none other than Young Master Mo Ran, who was at the peak of life and death. He said with integrity: "Vulgar and vulgar words are not acceptable, and they are not suitable for elegance."
Mo Ran smiled and said: "How elegant is this place? You are not ashamed."
After saying that, I suddenly heard a commotion downstairs.
"Oh! What a fast horse!"
"He must be the Immortal Lord at the top of life and death!"
There was a lot of discussion, and a dark horse galloped from the direction of the Peak of Death and Life, rushing into the juggling circle like lightning!
There were two people sitting on the horse. One was wearing a black hat and a black cloak, which was so tightly covered that his age and gender could not be identified. The other was a woman in her thirties or forties, with clumsy hands and a weathered face.
The woman burst into tears when she saw those man-bears. She climbed off the horse and stumbled over. She hugged one of the man-bears and knelt down and howled: "My son!!! My son——"
Everyone around was confused. Someone scratched their head and murmured: "Yeah? Isn't this the cub of the ancient mythical beast Pixiu? Why does this woman call it son?"
"Isn't this the female Pixiu?"
"Oh, it's so powerful. This mother has transformed into a human form."
The villagers here are ignorant and talking nonsense, but Mo Ran has figured it out.
According to legend, some Taoist priests would abduct children, then pluck out their tongues to render them speechless, then scald the children's skin with boiling water, and stick the animal skins on their bodies while the flesh and blood were still mutilated. After the blood solidified, the fur and children were glued together, making them look like monsters. These children cannot speak or write, so they can only be bullied and perform juggling acts such as "Pixiu Abacus". If they resist, they will be beaten with sticks.
No wonder he couldn't feel the slightest demonic energy before. These "Pixiu" are not demons at all, but real people...
He was thinking to himself, what the black cloak said in a low voice to the Taoist priests over there, when those Taoist priests heard the words, they became furious instantly, shouting, "Apologise? Your grandpa doesn't know how to write the word apology!" "What's so great about the summit of life and death?" "If you mind your own business, beat me up!" They rushed towards the black cloak and tried to beat him.
"Ouch."
Seeing his fellow students being beaten, Mo Ran laughed softly, "It's so fierce."
He had no intention of helping. In his previous life, he really hated the sect's atmosphere of drawing swords and helping each other when encountering difficulties. One or two of them would rush up like fools. Aunt Wang's cat at the entrance of the village had to ask them to help her when she couldn't climb a tree. From the sect leader to the handyman, everyone in the sect was thoughtless.
There are so many unfair things in the world, why do you care? It's exhausting for you.
"It's a fight! It's a fight! Drink! What a powerful fist!"
Up and down the restaurant, people crowded around to join in the fun.
"It's shameless to hit one of so many people!"
"Watch your back, Immortal Lord! Oh! It's so dangerous! Wow, oh, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah!"
"Well dodged this blow!"
These people like to watch fights, but Mo Ran doesn't like to watch them. He has seen a lot of bloody storms, and what happens under his nose is like a fly buzzing to him.. He lazily dusted the peanut crumbs off his clothes, got up and left.
After going downstairs, the Taoist priests were fighting with each other in black cloaks. The swords were swishing. Mo Ran crossed his arms and leaned against the door of the wine shop. He only glanced at them and couldn't help but clicked his tongue.
Everyone on the summit of life and death was as fierce and brave as ten, but this black cloak was not very good at fighting. He saw them being pulled off their horses by those Taoist priests, and they were surrounded and kicked fiercely, but they were not ruthless.
Instead, he weakly shouted: "A gentleman is trying to reason with you with his hands but not his mouth. Why don't you listen?!"
Taoist priests: “………………”
Mo Ran: "……………………"
What are the Taoist priests thinking? This person has been beaten to look like a grandma, how can a gentleman still use his words but not his hands? This is the head of a steamed bun, no filling, right?
Mo Ran's face suddenly changed, and he felt dizzy for a moment. He held his breath and opened his eyes in disbelief - this voice...
"Teacher!" Mo Ran shouted and rushed up hurriedly, filled with spiritual power and struck out with a palm, shaking away all five evil-doing Taoist priests! He knelt on the ground and held up the black cloak covered with muddy footprints. His voice couldn't help but tremble slightly——
"Teacher, is it you?"
The author has something to say: Although his name is Shi Mei, he is really Senior Brother, Senior Brother 23333
